GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #19 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Gute Nacht" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bye (friendly)
   B. good evening
   C. thank you
   D. good night

2. What does "Wie geht's?" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. How are you?
   B. thank you
   C. sorry, excuse me
   D. good day (daytime greeting)

3. What does "montags" mean in the tongue twister about the mother? (1 mark)
   A. on Mondays
   B. on Sundays
   C. tomorrow
   D. every morning

4. What does "der Sohn" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. brother
   B. uncle
   C. friend
   D. son

5. What does "der Bruder" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. mother
   B. sister
   C. brother
   D. aunt

6. What does "das Sofa" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. garden
   B. plate
   C. sofa
   D. fridge

7. What does "die Lampe" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. lamp
   B. kitchen
   C. garden
   D. house

8. What does "das Fenster" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. table
   B. bathroom
   C. bed
   D. window

9. How is the "g" pronounced at the end of "Tag"? (1 mark)
   A. It is silent
   B. like k
   C. like g in go
   D. like j

10. How is "ie" pronounced in "Dienstag"? (1 mark)
   A. like eye
   B. like ow
   C. like oy
   D. like ee

11. What number is "vierzehn"? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 9
   C. 17
   D. 14

12. What does "der Luftballon" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. present
   B. party
   C. birthday
   D. balloon

13. Which sentence means "I like eating bananas"? (1 mark)
   A. Ich esse keine Bananen.
   B. Ich trinke gern Bananen.
   C. Ich esse gern Bananen.
   D. Ich koche Bananen.

14. What does "das Ei" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. meat
   B. egg
   C. fish
   D. sugar

15. In the word "Knie", which letters are both said? (1 mark)
   A. only n
   B. k and n
   C. only k
   D. neither

16. How many fingers do we have on two hands? (1 mark)
   A. zehn
   B. sechs
   C. zwölf
   D. acht

17. What does "Es regnet" mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is hot
   B. It is raining
   C. It is snowing
   D. It is windy

18. What does "der Schnee" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cloud
   B. wind
   C. snow
   D. thunderstorm

19. What does "trinken" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to sing
   B. to sleep
   C. to drink
   D. to read

20. What does "sprechen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to eat
   B. to play
   C. to help
   D. to speak

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the seven days of the week in German in order, starting with Monday. (4 marks)

22. Write in German: "The sun is shining." (2 marks)

23. Write the German words with der, die or das for: head, eye, mouth, hand. (4 marks)

24. Explain when to use "mein" and when to use "meine". Give one example of each. (3 marks)

25. Explain what it means to listen for the gist of a text. (2 marks)

26. Give two reasons why fruit and vegetables are good for the body. (2 marks)

27. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cake, candle, present. (3 marks)

28. Say why the word "Schlafzimmer" is a das word. (2 marks)

29. Write three German sentences that say where things are in a house, using im or in der. (3 marks)

30. Read: "Heute ist Samstag. Vater liest im Wohnzimmer. Mutter kocht in der Küche." Give the gist. (3 marks)

31. Write in German: "Today is Wednesday. Tomorrow is Thursday." (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #19 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — good night
   Gute Nacht means good night.

2. A — How are you?
   Wie geht's? means How are you?.

3. A — on Mondays
   Montags means on Mondays, or every Monday.

4. D — son
   der Sohn means son.

5. C — brother
   der Bruder means brother.

6. C — sofa
   das Sofa means sofa.

7. A — lamp
   die Lampe means lamp.

8. D — window
   das Fenster means window.

9. B — like k
   Tag is said TAHK.

10. D — like ee
   The letters ie sound like ee.

11. D — 14
   vierzehn is the number 14.

12. D — balloon
   der Luftballon means balloon.

13. C — Ich esse gern Bananen.
   gern shows you like doing it.

14. B — egg
   das Ei means egg.

15. B — k and n
   In German you say both letters: k-nee.

16. A — zehn
   zehn is ten.

17. B — It is raining
   regnen is to rain.

18. C — snow
   der Schnee means snow.

19. C — to drink
   trinken means to drink.

20. D — to speak
   sprechen means to speak.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag, Sonntag.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for all seven correct; lose 1 mark for every two errors.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Die Sonne scheint.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Die Sonne and 1 mark for scheint.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Kopf, das Auge, der Mund, die Hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Use mein with der and das nouns (mein Vater) and meine with die nouns and plurals (meine Mutter).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule and 1 mark for correct examples.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: It means listening for the main idea, such as who is speaking and what is happening, without needing every word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the main idea, 1 mark for not needing every word.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: They give vitamins and energy; they help us to stay healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Kuchen, die Kerze, das Geschenk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Its last part, Zimmer, is a das word, and a joined word takes the article of the last part.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for last part, 1 mark for Zimmer being das.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is Saturday. Father is reading in the living room and Mother is cooking in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three facts.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Heute ist Mittwoch. Morgen ist Donnerstag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.
